messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm opening a bulk PR to update CODEOWNERS for runtime/ and runtime-kernels/ to assign ownership to the eng-runtime team. This touches a bunch of files currently owned by individual engineers so I want to confirm approval routing before I push. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234
Maria: Do we have an established rule for runtime/* today? If the current CODEOWNERS lists individuals, changing that might require each listed owner to sign off.
Alex: Current snippet in the repo (copy):
```
# current CODEOWNERS excerpt
/runtime/ @sahil @jessica
/runtime-kernels/ @daniel
```
Alex: Proposal is to replace with team ownership like:
```
/runtime/ @eng-runtime
/runtime-kernels/ @eng-runtime
```
Alex: Question: can we accept a proxy approval from team leads instead of getting each individual owner to approve?
Tim: We don't have proxy semantics in CODEOWNERS itself, but operationally we've accepted "team lead" signoff for mass ownership moves in the past. Suggested process: 1) add a PR label `owners-bulk`, 2) get explicit approvals from 2 team leads (eng-runtime lead + eng-platform lead), 3) include a CHANGELOG section and rollback steps.
Ryan: Agree with Tim. For safety, also run a quick canary on a stage cluster if runtime changes affect infra. I'll +1 once CI passes and the PR body contains the changelog + rollback plan.
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ (unit tests, lint, build) — 1834123550
Maria: OK from me — +1. @Tim if you can be the second approver that'd be ideal, otherwise @Ryan please +1 when ready.
Tim: I'm +1. Two quick asks: 1) include a note about who to DM for immediate rollback (pager contact), 2) put the exact list of files changed in the PR so owners have a concise diff to skim.
Alex: Will do. I'll finalize the PR description with the file list, CHANGELOG, rollback steps, and add label `owners-bulk`. Planning to request merge during Friday's merge window after a short staging canary. Thanks everyone — will ping when it's ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/compare/PR-1234
